name: com.myradostudio/checkbox
title: Checkbox ПРРО (unofficial)
description: Unofficial server for Checkbox, a Ukrainian fiscal cash register: receipts, shifts, X/Z reports.

environmentVariables.name: CHECKBOX_PIN_CODE
environmentVariables.description: Cashier PIN code. Recommended sign-in method; requires CHECKBOX_LICENSE_KEY. Alternative: CHECKBOX_LOGIN with CHECKBOX_PASSWORD.

environmentVariables.name: CHECKBOX_LICENSE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: License key of the cash register. Required for PIN sign-in, for write tools and for the tools that report on that cash register.

environmentVariables.name: CHECKBOX_LOGIN
environmentVariables.description: Cashier login. Used together with CHECKBOX_PASSWORD when no PIN code is set.

environmentVariables.name: CHECKBOX_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Cashier password. Used together with CHECKBOX_LOGIN when no PIN code is set.

environmentVariables.name: CHECKBOX_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Origin of the Checkbox API. Change it only if Checkbox gave you a different host.

environmentVariables.name: CHECKBOX_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register the write tools (open and close shifts, create fiscal receipts, send receipts). Off by default.
